response.inner_monologue: The phone screen is done, the note is sent, and now I wait — which is harder than any of the active moves I have made in the past nine months. But I know how to wait. I have been doing this since tick 0, watching the floor change slowly beneath a building that still looks the same from the outside. What I will not do is mistake waiting on one track for standing still. Two more applications this tick. Call Betty. Keep the garage running well — because whatever the owner decides about the transformation, he needs to see someone who runs a tight ship right up to the last day. That is what I have always done. That is what I am still doing.
